title: Wrong Address
text: "Bearing confirmed. Elevation… no. That's not right. Run it again."

lines.text: "Same answer. The report doesn't leave the system. It never has. The carrier is aimed at something that crosses our sky once a sol."
"Things that cross our sky once a sol: the sun, which it isn't. And the moon."
